lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits. The pattern is organized into approximately five vertical columns between the pectoral fin base and the first dorsal fin, with spots aligned in roughly parallel horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a lattice-like structure, most prominent in the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature runs along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a high-intensity dorsal region to a shadowed ventral gradient.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; the distal margin of the visible pectoral fin shows irregular scalloping.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a unique high-density distribution of small-diameter high-luminance spots that are significantly more compact and numerous than the larger grid-patterned spots on the primary torso.
